Name: Playable Kalimba
Author: Mushroomyx
Description:
This mod adds a Kalimba to the game, which you can use to play music freely, or to play MIDI files.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915] Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28551] Playable Piano[/url]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to Obtain[/size]
To Obtain the Kalimba you must first reach Foraging Level 3, this will unlock the Kalimba's crafting recipe.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/btrFgFc.png[/img]

Afterwards The Kalimba can be crafted using 3 Iron Bars and 50 Wood.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xoRxbAt.png[/img]

[size=5]How to Use[/size]
To play the Kalimba, hold it in your hand and press LMB. You then can either play in Freeplay Mode, by pressing keys on your Keyboard, or play MIDI Files in the MIDI Playback mode. For further information check out the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28551] Playable Piano Mod Page[/url].

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player.
[*]UI may be broken in split-screen mode.
[*]Multiplayer works, if all players have the corresponding soundfiles.
[/list]
